PREFERENCES & DATA

Settings

Your collection is saved locally in this browser. Export backups before clearing browser data.

⚙

Backup health

Imports show changes before applying and keep one recovery copy on this device. Older backups preserve companions, items and builds that they do not contain. Weekly reminders appear here in the app.

Import & export

Build-tab screenshot scanning uses on-device OCR for landscape Capability Awakening images. Review all detected values before saving; images are not uploaded to our server.

Storage & privacy

Your edits auto-save in this browser using local storage. Clearing site data may erase them. Export a backup regularly. Accounts, cloud sync, and automated game-data updates are not available. OCR downloads its recognition engine on first use.

Artwork

Choose each Prismana’s Sparkling color in its Appearance tab. Paste a direct image URL or select a saved image from your device. The appearance gallery supports built-in images through the art manifest, plus personal overrides. Uploaded appearance galleries are preserved. Built-in portraits use your supplied screenshot galleries throughout; all five recovered galleries retain their original 13 appearances. Irisalis still needs matching artwork. Held-item artwork includes 27 screenshot-sourced icons; newly cataloged items start at zero owned until you update inventory. Aniilog numbers use region-specific numbering. Cornet keeps the legacy Coronet record so saved builds stay linked.
